summary: Celestica Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its senior credit agreement on April 27, 2026. The amendment increases revolving credit facility commitments from $750 million to $1.75 billion, refinances an existing term loan into a new $250 million term loan, and extends maturities to April 2031. This is a routine refinancing and upsizing of existing credit lines for general corporate purposes, not a special situation. No specific terms like price per share or premium are applicable; the filing involves standard debt amendments without any event-driven change in corporate structure, control, or strategy. This is a material definitive agreement but lacks special-situation characteristics.
